images.filename: Castles of Munster, Moycarkey, Tipperary - geograph.org.uk - 1542271.jpg
images.caption: Castles of Munster: Moycarkey, Tipperary This five storey tower is located about a mile to the northwest of the town of Horse & Jockey set within a large rectangular bawn. There is a circular bartizan on the SW corner, and a box machicolation is set high up over the entrance. In 1640 the castle was held by William Cantwell.
images.alt: Castles of Munster: Moycarkey, Tipperary This five storey tower is located about a mile to the northwest of the town of Horse & Jockey set within a large rectangular bawn. There is a circular bartizan on the SW corner, and a box machicolation is set high up over the entrance. In 1640 the castle was held by William Cantwell.
categories: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland

images.caption: Ruins of Cloghscregg Castle, a former Cantwell castle. Only one corner remains with the original castle's dimension being approx. 10x10m. The wall facing the photographer is 1.14m thick. There is one window and one corbel stone remaining in the North-Eastern wall, at least one corbel stone on the ground. Traces of the external walls about 0.3m high all around.
